name: WebTheory Media
website: https://webtheoryppc.com/ (now serving unrelated Indonesian gambling content - see website_review)
what_they_do: Small pay-per-click agency (WebTheory Media LLC / 'WebTheory PPC') selling Google Ads and Meta/LinkedIn ad management, plus landing-page and conversion work. Clutch profile describes PPC management as the core service with analytics and CRO as support.
customers: Small and mid-size businesses buying paid search/social management; Clutch review sample includes a record label (inference: B2B, marketing-budget holders).

size_signals.signal: Clutch profile lists 2 verified reviews, both 5.0 - consistent with a 1-5 person shop
Listed in WP Engine agency directory as 'WebTheory Media LLC'
Directory listings give 330 Constitution Cir, North Brunswick, NJ 08902 and (732) 858-6291

listing.platform: Clutch (agency directory); Yellow Pages/Superpages also list it

website_review.primary_cta: none on the current domain (page is an Indonesian togel/gambling product page with 'MASUK/DAFTAR' buttons)
website_review.trust_signals: none on the current domain; trust exists only off-site (Clutch reviews, WP Engine directory)
website_review.out_of_date_signs: The domain webtheoryppc.com now returns a completely unrelated Indonesian gambling site (title 'OLI4D ... Toto Macau'), with schema.org Product markup naming OLI4D - the agency's own site is gone or the domain was lost/hijacked
website_review.search_basics: No agency page title, description or service pages exist on the domain any more; nothing names North Brunswick or PPC services
top_issues: Live domain serves hijacked/unrelated gambling content - brand and any SEO equity are effectively destroyed
No website a customer or an AI agent can read for services, pricing or contact
No visible quote/contact path; Clutch profile is the only online storefront

agent_readiness.notes: No Google Business Profile could be confirmed (Google served a bot check to this browser). Robots.txt not assessable since the domain no longer hosts the agency. Zero readable service/hours/pricing text; no LocalBusiness JSON-LD for the agency (the only JSON-LD on the domain is for the gambling site). No form or booking anywhere.

operations_signals.signal: Two 5.0 Clutch reviews mention communication and ongoing campaign optimization - no complaints visible, but sample is tiny

top_opportunities.opportunity: Recover the domain / rebuild a 5-page site with services, pricing bands, case studies and a quote form
top_opportunities.evidence: webtheoryppc.com currently serves an unrelated Indonesian gambling page under the agency's own domain

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim/complete Google Business Profile and add LocalBusiness JSON-LD so the agency can be found and quoted by AI assistants
top_opportunities.evidence: No verifiable Google listing or on-site structured data; only directory/citation listings carry the NAP

top_opportunities.opportunity: Set up an intake + proposal-follow-up agent to replace ad-hoc email contact
top_opportunities.evidence: Only contact route found is directory phone number and an off-site Clutch profile

scores.reasons: Gap is maxed - the domain is serving spam and there is no usable web presence. Ability to pay is modest (tiny PPC shop with 2 reviews). Ease is high because a losing domain plus a small site are quick wins. Evidence is moderate: Clutch and directories confirm the business, but no Google profile could be read.

wrong_claims.claim: No Google Business Profile could be confirmed / agent_readiness findable: 1 / opportunity: 'Claim/complete Google Business Profile'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: A Google Maps search for the agency name returns two 'WebTheory PPC' listings, both open and both rated 5.0: an 'Advertising agency' at 14 Old Bridge Tpke Ste 203, South River NJ 08882, phone (732) 655-9038, with the website field pointing at webtheoryppc.com; and an 'Internet marketing service' at 607 Lake Ave, phone (732) 800-9867. So a profile exists (possibly as duplicates, possibly after a move from the directory NAP of 330 Constitution Cir, North Brunswick, which matches neither address). The real opportunity is fixing the profile's website link and consolidating duplicates, not claiming a profile from scratch. I could not confirm that either listing is the same legal entity as WebTheory Media LLC.
